entities.summary: Admiral Sir Edwyn Sinclair Alexander-Sinclair, was a Scottish Royal Navy officer, notable for firing the first shots of the Battle of Jutland, and for leading a squadron of light cruisers in the Baltic to support independence of Estonia and Latvia in 1918 to 1919.
